== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rebel Scout (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Rebel Scout]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100692 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100692], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100692-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8a29a61a1469e23a5daf14f0b4cf2c156df08a926185c64ddfd2afc4c8bbad90</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
